events.title: First Job
events.text: {person:child} wants to take a part-time job after school. They are glowing with plans.

choices.label: Encourage them completely
choices.outcome_text: First paycheck. Unbearable pride on both sides.

choices.label: Negotiate: school first, job second
choices.outcome_text: We wrote a contract more thorough than most businesses manage.

choices.label: No. School is the job
choices.outcome_text: The glow went out like a switched-off lamp.

events.title: Learner's Permit
events.text: {person:child} has the learner's permit booklet open on every surface of the house.

choices.label: Pay for proper lessons
choices.outcome_text: The instructor said they were a natural.

choices.label: They save half, you match half
choices.outcome_text: Hard-earned lessons mean more, we both decided.

choices.label: Driving can wait
choices.outcome_text: The booklet migrated sulkily to a shelf.

events.title: The Concert
events.text: Everyone is going to the concert this weekend, according to {person:child}, and life will be ruined without it.

choices.label: Buy the ticket
choices.outcome_text: I bought the concert ticket, and my teen came home hoarse and floating.

choices.label: They pay their own way
choices.outcome_text: An extra shift, an earned ticket, visible pride.

choices.label: Absolutely not
choices.outcome_text: The weekend was quiet in a bad way.

events.title: All-Night Raids
events.text: {person:child}'s sleep schedule has been replaced by a raid schedule.

choices.label: Upgrade the setup — be the cool parent
choices.outcome_text: I upgraded my teen's gaming setup and achieved legendary parent status, apparently.

choices.label: Enforce hard limits
choices.outcome_text: The household alarm is now called 'the unplugging'.

choices.label: Choose your battles
choices.outcome_text: The raids continued. So did everything else, barely.

events.title: Everyone Has One
events.text: {person:child} has entered the 'everyone has a phone except me' phase. Fact-checks are inconclusive.

choices.label: Get a new phone
choices.outcome_text: The unboxing ceremony was extensively documented.

choices.label: Hand down your old one
choices.outcome_text: A cracked screen is apparently a personality.

choices.label: Not until you can pay the bill
choices.outcome_text: They started a savings jar with dramatic flair.

events.title: College Talks
events.text: Serious conversations about the future have begun. {person:child} is waiting to hear what you think.

choices.label: Promise to fund it fully
choices.outcome_text: A weight visibly lifted off young shoulders.

choices.label: Advise local options, honestly
choices.outcome_text: A spreadsheet was involved. They appreciated it.

choices.label: It's your life — your call
choices.outcome_text: Freedom was given. It looked heavier than expected.

events.title: The Slammed Door
events.text: Last night ended with a slammed door and words neither of you meant.

choices.label: Apologise first
choices.outcome_text: Turns out they had been rehearsing an apology too.

choices.label: Hold the line — you were right
choices.outcome_text: The rules held. The warmth took a week to return.

choices.label: Let it cool down naturally
choices.outcome_text: I let the argument with my teen cool down naturally; peace arrived quietly over breakfast.
